title: Bound on cumulative miss probability
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of positive degree $D$, and let $s,t$ be vertices such that $t$ is reachable from $s$ by a finite sequence of adjacency steps. For every natural number $N$, the cumulative miss probability for hitting $t$ from $s$ through step $N-1$ is at most $2D|V|^3$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular multigraph of positive degree $D$
A finite sequence of adjacency steps from $s$ to $t$
